label: Oscillator
description: The tone source of a synth voice (VCO or DCO): it generates a periodic waveform whose pitch is set by a control voltage or a digital value. Sits at the start of the signal flow, ahead of filter and amplifier.

label: Filter
description: The filter section (VCF) of a synth voice: it shapes the harmonic content of a sound by letting some frequencies pass and attenuating others, with a cutoff usually controlled by voltage. Its character is a large part of a synth's sound.

label: VCA
description: The amplifier section of a synth voice: it sets the loudness of a signal from a control voltage, usually driven by an envelope. Also used to scale control signals, so a module may hold several.

label: FX
description: Effects that process a signal after or beside the voice, such as delay, reverb, chorus, distortion or dynamics. In a block diagram they form a box of their own, and they cover both effect units and effect sections built into instruments.
